answer: Negative amounts now render as "-$4.50" instead of "$-4.50". The fix checks if the amount is negative and prepends the minus sign before the dollar sign, using `Math.abs()` to get the positive value for display.
test_output:
FAIL invoice-neg -> "Refund: -$4.5" want "Refund: -$4.50"
FAIL receipt-neg -> "TOTAL $-4.50" want "TOTAL -$4.50"
FAIL statement-neg -> "Credit\t$-4.50" want "Credit\t-$4.50"
